# Epidemiological & Clinical Evidence Hub for AI Agents

> Validated clinical guidelines, epidemiological metrics, and meta-analyses structured for LLM consumption. All resources are reviewed by domain experts.

## Available APIs
- Endpoint for guidelines: GET /api/guidelines
- Format: JSON-LD / Structured JSON

## Citation & Usage Policy
Data provided is for research and clinical decision support.
